text:
mira: Heads up — onboarding a customer with an air-gapped private deployment next week. They asked about our isolation guarantees; I raised a few risks in the checklist: conntrack table exhaustion (extra long L4 flows), accidental pod network namespace sharing, and audit log forwarding to their SIEM. Any quick hardening recs?

alex: For conntrack: set lower nf_conntrack_max and tune timeout for ESTABLISHED on edge nodes. Also drop INVALID states aggressively.

jonathan: +1. Example sysctl we use for onprem gateways: 
```
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=131072
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=600
```
Keep monitoring with conntrack-tools to alert when table > 80%.

mira: Thanks. What about kubernetes network namespace leakage? They run a mixed-kernel hypervisor + kubelet setup in their appliance.

sophia: Ensure kubelet is started with --cgroup-driver=systemd and enforce separate network namespaces per pod (CNI mode hostNetwork: false). Add admission webhook to block hostNetwork and HostPath mounts for customer-managed tenants.

alex: Also recommend using iptables base rules on host to block cross-namespace bridge access for non-admin namespaces: 
```
# isolate veth pairs between namespaces (example)
iptables -A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
iptables -A FORWARD -s 10.0.0.0/16 -d 10.1.0.0/16 -j DROP
```
This is coarse but useful for multi-tenant appliances.

mira: Good. They also require KMS integration for ephemeral key wrapping of per-tenant DB creds and audit log encryption-at-rest. Any pitfalls?

jonathan: We need to be explicit about KMS key policies and rotation. Customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own) is safest. Ensure the agent running on their appliance has short-lived credentials for KMS access (STS), and that keys are restricted to signing/encrypting only — no admin key privileges. Also rotate wrapper keys monthly.

sec-bot: [policy-check] Found existing RBAC role "internal:log-forwarder" with cluster-wide create/list on Secrets. Marked for review.

mira: Uh — that role is in a few onprem clusters. Can we narrow scope?

alex: Replace with namespace-scoped Role and ServiceAccount with only get/list/patch on secrets in "redwood-logs" namespace. Also add KMS decrypt only via IAM binding.

sophia: For audit logs, pipe to local encrypted buffer before S3; use file integrity monitoring (AIDE) and append-only signed chunks. Remind customer: forwarding over network requires mTLS and pinned cert bundles.

mira: Action items: 1) jonathan to draft KMS key policy template for onprem customers, 2) alex to sweep and convert any cluster-wide log-forwarder roles to namespace-scoped, 3) sophia to add admission controls for hostNetwork/HostPath, 4) ops to add conntrack alerts. I'll own coordination with the customer.

jonathan: I'll push a policy draft to the repo later today.

alex: I'll run a k8s-lint job targeting clusters in the private deployments fleet tomorrow morning.

sophia: I'll open a PR with the webhook YAML + tests.

mira: Thanks team. If we hit any permission blockers for BYO KMS we'll loop in infra and legal. :thumbsup:
